name: adamson/applications
title: Applications
description: Two large photo cards (Touring / Install) with a huge layered word across the top, a label and an arrow link.

fields.label: Big word
fields.help: Huge word across the top of the card, e.g. TOURING. It is stretched to fill the card width.

fields.label: Link
fields.help: Where the card and its arrow go. Only the URL is used; the label above is the visible text.

fields.label: Background image
fields.help: Full-card photo behind the big word (about 765 × 770, anchored to the bottom).

fields.label: Foreground cut-out
fields.help: Optional transparent PNG with the same framing as the background; it sits in front of the big word.
